trickyParts: The diff scope in dogfood.md uses jj's fork_point(<default>@origin | @-): a plain --from <default>@origin shows the default branch's later commits as deletions once it has moved.
agent-browser embeds axe-core (MPL-2.0); its two licence files are in the image notices. Its Rust lockfile is cli/Cargo.lock, so crates() takes an optional lockfile path.
Image proof namespace is the pod's workload namespace (compute class <compute class>); legion refuses Job creation from this pod.
The eval kernel's default completion model is refused by the gateway (context_management); the stand-in ran on the 'slow' model, the arms on the default agent model.
